prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
ai_overview_text:
The best online courses for shadow work and spiritual integration combine Jungian psychology, somatic practices, and meditative awareness: www.awakeacademy.org +2
Instructor: Dr. James Hollis
Format: 4 classes (4 hours), priced at $127 (includes videos, audio, and companion guide).
Focus: Deep dive into Jungian shadow formation, projection in relationships, and recurring life patterns to foster psychological responsibility. Jung Platform
Instructor: Charlie Morley
Format: 7-week guided course.
Focus: Merges Tibetan Buddhist methods with Western psychology and dream work to transform and integrate the shadow with loving-kindness. www.awakeacademy.org
Instructors: Dr. Swami Shankardev Saraswati and Jayne Stevenson.
Format: Self-paced with email support.
Focus: Blends traditional yoga psychology, meditation, dream analysis, and Western psychotherapy. Big Shakti
Instructor: Melanie Stevens
Format: 16 sections, over 2 hours of video plus journaling prompts.
Focus: Beginner-friendly inner reflection, chakra self-care, identifying triggers, and shadow communication. Udemy
Instructors: Various lineage teachers, Pema Chödrön, Eckhart Tolle, and Tara Brach.
Format: Flexible self-paced digital programs.
Focus: Bridges emotional healing, ego work, and contemplative spiritual practice. Sounds True +1
Format: 15-video playlist and 5-hour breakdown.
Focus: Somatic release, shadow relationships, inner critics, and Jungian concepts. YouTube·Jordan Thornton - Inner Work
